questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 1 What are Polymers?
questions.question: 支链聚合物
questions.ref: UNIT 1 What are Polymers? · 词汇表
questions.evidence: When we speak of a branched polymer, we refer to the presence of additional polymeric chains issuing from the backbone of a linear molecule.
questions.explanation: 注意是 branched 而非 branch；与 linear polymer、cross-linked polymer 对照记忆。

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 1 What are Polymers?
questions.question: 粘度
questions.ref: UNIT 1 What are Polymers? · 词汇表
questions.evidence: The viscosity of the saturated salt solution is not very much different from that of water.
questions.explanation: “聚合物溶液粘度远高于水”是教材反复强调的判据。

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 6 Polymer Solution
questions.question: 结晶性
questions.evidence: This may be all that happens if, for example, the polymer-polymer intermolecular forces are high because of crosslinking, crystallinity, or strong hydrogen bonding.1 But if these forces can be overcome by the introduction of strong polymer-solvent interactions, the second stage of solution can take place.
questions.explanation: 名词形式；形容词 crystalline，半结晶 semi-crystalline。

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers
questions.question: 模量
questions.ref: UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers · 词汇表
questions.evidence: At room temperature these polymers may be of high modulus, such as polymethyl methacrylate, polystyrene and melt-quenched polyethylene terephthalate, or of low modulus, such as rubber or atactic polypropylene.
questions.explanation: 复数 moduli；storage modulus 储能模量、loss modulus 损耗模量。
